---
title: "Syllabus"
output: html_document
---

```{r generate_dates, include=FALSE}
## first day of class
start_date <- as.Date("2027-01-04")
## all mon
mon <- seq.Date(from = start_date, by = 7, length.out = 10)
## all wed
wed <- mon + 2
## all fri
fri <- wed + 2
## all qtr
dates <- sort(c(mon, wed, fri))
dates <- sub("0(\\d)", "\\1", format(dates, "%d %b"))
## add placeholder for background info
qtr <- c("", dates)
```
